The '''Imperial Navy Research, Development and Engineering Center''' was a scientific organization working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
It worked on Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]] designs, including the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].
